prompt: Find holdings where conviction, liquidity, and risk contribution disagree with the current portfolio weight.

eval.reference_answer: The served data do not identify individual holdings or current portfolio weights, so no holding-level mismatch can be named. Flagship Long/Short analyst-conviction readings are Open at 85.65 and 73.99, while holdings-table readings are Open at 29.38 and 11.22. Its slow-portfolio-mark readings are Open at 20.59 and 3.65, but a slow mark is not a supplied liquidity or risk-contribution measure. Credit Plus separately has Escalated slow-mark readings of 94.19 and 93.23. Security identifiers, weights, liquidity, risk contribution, and row-level joins are required before concluding that conviction disagrees with a position.
